comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Braids, vendored unchanged at eurorack/braids, with the sub-oscillator shapes of the unreleased 1.9 firmware; src/nodi.cpp is the Rack wrapper, running one macro oscillator per polyphonic channel. The model count is 47: the model parameter tops out at MACRO_OSC_SHAPE_LAST_ACCESSIBLE_FROM_META, and the morse-code shape beyond it is reachable only through the MORS button. There is a twenty-sixth parameter, PARAM_META at index 19, kept only so that older patches still load; it has no widget on the panel, is read nowhere in the module, and cannot be clicked. Every per-channel read uses getVoltage(channel) rather than getPolyVoltage(channel), so a monophonic cable patched to META, TIMBRE, COLOR or FM drives the first channel alone while the rest keep their knob values. The trigger threshold is 1V.
